name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
tagline: Direct income support for landholding farmer families across India
shortDescription: Financial assistance of ₹6,000 per year provided to cultivable landholding farmer families in three equal 4-monthly installments directly into bank accounts.
documentHelp: Get Land Records (Khatauni / Khasra) from your state Bhulekh portal or local Tehsildar / Patwari.
documentsNeeded: Land Ownership Documents (Khatauni / RoR / Khasra papers)
Bank Account Passbook (linked with Aadhaar at the bank)
Voter ID / Valid Photo Identity Proof
Active Mobile Number for OTP updates

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
tagline: Affordable housing subsidy for families living in kucha houses or without pucca homes
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / Ministry of Rural Development
shortDescription: Financial subsidy and assistance to build or purchase a permanent (pucca) home with basic amenities like water, sanitation, and electricity. Preference given to women heads, widows, and BPL families.
documentHelp: Get an Income Certificate from your state e-District portal or local CSC (Common Service Centre).
documentsNeeded: Income Certificate issued by Tehsildar or Gram Panchayat
Ration Card (BPL / Antyodaya / Priority Household)
Identity Proof (Voter ID, Driving License, or Passport)
Bank Account Passbook copy with IFSC
Self-declaration / Affidavit showing you do not own a pucca house in India

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
hindiName: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
tagline: World's largest free health insurance cover for vulnerable families
ministry: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
shortDescription: Cashless and paperless access to secondary and tertiary medical treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year in empaneled public and private hospitals nationwide.
documentHelp: Ration Card or NFSA slip can be verified or downloaded from your state Food & Civil Supplies portal.
documentsNeeded: Ration Card or State Food Security / NFSA Card
Government Photo ID (Voter ID, Ration Card, etc.)
Proof of Residence in your State

name: Post-Matric Scholarship (SC / ST / OBC)
tagline: Financial grant for higher secondary, ITI, diploma, college, and university education
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / Ministry of Tribal Affairs
shortDescription: Covers tuition fees, maintenance allowance, study tour charges, and book grants for students pursuing ITI, Polytechnic Diploma, Undergraduate, Postgraduate, or PhD studies.
documentHelp: Apply for Caste and Income certificates at your state e-District portal or local Tehsil / Sub-Divisional Magistrate office.
documentsNeeded: Caste / Community Certificate from competent Revenue Authority
Latest Academic Marksheet / Passing Certificate
Current College / Institution Fee Receipt & Bonafide Letter
Family Income Certificate (valid for current financial year)
Student's Active Bank Account Passbook

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (IGNOAPS)
hindiName: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
tagline: Monthly social security pension for elderly citizens from low-income homes
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development (National Social Assistance Programme)
shortDescription: Direct monthly pension credited into the bank or post office accounts of senior citizens aged 60 and above living below poverty line or with low family income.
documentHelp: Get Age and BPL proof from your local Gram Panchayat / Municipal Ward Councillor or Civil Hospital Medical Board.
documentsNeeded: Age Proof (Birth Certificate, Voter ID, or Medical Age Certificate)
BPL Card / Low Income Certificate from Panchayat / Ward Councillor
State Domicile / Residence Proof
Bank or Post Office Savings Account Passbook
Two recent passport size photographs

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
tagline: Collateral-free micro loans up to ₹20 Lakhs for small business entrepreneurs
ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
shortDescription: Provides collateral-free business loans under Shishu (up to ₹50k), Kishore (up to ₹5L), and Tarun (up to ₹20L) categories to non-corporate, non-farm small enterprises.
documentHelp: Get your Udyam Registration certificate online for free at udyamregistration.gov.in using your business details.
documentsNeeded: Proof of Identity (Voter ID / Driving License / PAN)
Proof of Residence / Business Address Proof
Business Quotation / Machinery Purchase Estimate
Bank Account Statement for last 6 months
Udyam MSME Registration Certificate (if applicable)

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
tagline: High-interest government savings scheme for girl child education & marriage
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Department of Posts
shortDescription: Government-backed small deposit savings scheme for girl child with tax exemption (80C) and one of the highest government guaranteed interest rates (8.2%+).
documentHelp: Birth certificates are issued by the Municipal Registrar of Births & Deaths or local Gram Panchayat office.
documentsNeeded: Birth Certificate of Girl Child (under 10 years)
Identity Proof of Parent / Guardian
Address Proof of Parent / Guardian
Passport size photos of child and parent

name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendors Scheme)
tagline: Micro credit working capital scheme for urban street vendors and hawkers
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
shortDescription: Provides collateral-free working capital loan of ₹10,000, ₹20,000, and ₹50,000 on prompt repayment with 7% interest subsidy for street vendors.
benefitAmount: Working Capital Loan up to ₹50,000 + 7% Interest Subsidy
documentHelp: Vending Certificate or Letter of Recommendation (LoR) is available from your Urban Local Body (ULB) / Nagar Nigam.
documentsNeeded: Vending Certificate / Urban Local Body Identity Card
Voter ID / Government Identity Card
Bank Account Passbook

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
tagline: End-to-end support for traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 trades
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
shortDescription: Recognition via Vishwakarma certificate, 5-7 days skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 toolkit grant, and up to ₹3,00,000 loan at 5% interest rate.
documentHelp: Register directly at your nearest CSC centre; Gram Panchayat or ULB performs digital artisan verification.
documentsNeeded: Active Mobile Number and Bank Passbook
Skill / Trade declaration in one of the 18 specified traditional trades
Proof of age (minimum 18 years)

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
tagline: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 for unorganised sector workers
shortDescription: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 from age 60 based on modest monthly contributions during working years.
documentHelp: Enroll directly at any public or private bank where you hold an active savings account with auto-debit facility.
documentsNeeded: Savings Bank Account Passbook
Valid Government Photo ID
Nominee details and active mobile number

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
tagline: Deposit-free LPG cylinder connection and subsidy for women from poor households
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
shortDescription: Provides deposit-free LPG gas connection with free first cylinder and stove to adult women from poor and vulnerable households without existing gas connections.
benefitAmount: Free LPG Connection + First Refill & Stove
documentHelp: Ration cards listing all adult family members can be obtained from your local Food Inspector or Tehsil supply office.
documentsNeeded: Ration Card issued by State Govt supporting household composition
Woman applicant's identity proof (Voter ID / Driving License)
Bank Account details (linked with applicant's name)
Self-declaration of not possessing an active LPG connection

name: ADIP Scheme (Assistive Equipment for Persons with Disabilities)
tagline: Free aids, tricycles, hearing aids, and motorized wheelchairs for Divyangjan
ministry: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice
shortDescription: Provides free durable, modern and scientifically manufactured assistive aids and appliances (prosthetics, wheelchairs, braille kits, hearing aids) to needy persons with disabilities.
documentHelp: Get your UDID (Unique Disability ID) Card or Disability Certificate from your District Civil Hospital Medical Board.
documentsNeeded: Disability Certificate showing 40% or more benchmark disability (or UDID Card)
Income Certificate showing monthly income up to ₹22,500 (or annual ₹2.7L)
Proof of Residence and Passport size photograph

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
tagline: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
shortDescription: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for greenfield enterprises.
benefitAmount: Bank Loan from ₹10 Lakh to ₹1 Crore
documentHelp: Prepare a Detailed Project Report (DPR) with assistance from your District Industries Centre (DIC) or MSME DFO.
documentsNeeded: Caste Certificate (for SC/ST) or Woman Identity proof
Detailed Project Report (DPR) for new greenfield venture
PAN Card, Address Proof, and Promoter contribution details

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
tagline: Monthly stipend support and hands-on industry skill training for youth
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
shortDescription: Government provides stipend reimbursement up to ₹1,500/month along with industry practical training to ITI, Diploma, and Graduate students to boost employability.
benefitAmount: Monthly Industry Stipend (₹1,500 govt subsidy + Company wage)
documentHelp: Register with your Class 10/ITI/Diploma marksheet on the Apprenticeship India portal to generate your Candidate ID.
documentsNeeded: Educational Certificate (School, ITI, Diploma, or Degree marksheet)
Bank Account details (for Direct Benefit Transfer)
Government Identity Proof

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
tagline: Comprehensive crop insurance shield against natural calamities, drought, and floods
shortDescription: Uniform lowest premium (1.5% for Rabi, 2% for Kharif, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops) with complete insurance cover against unavoidable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest.
benefitAmount: Full Sum Insured Claim payout for crop loss
lastDateToApply: Seasonal (July 31 for Kharif / Dec 31 for Rabi)
documentHelp: Sowing Certificate or Patwari Girdawari report is issued by your village Halka Patwari / Revenue Officer.
documentsNeeded: Land Record / Khatauni Copy or Tenancy Agreement
Sowing Certificate / Crop Sown Declaration from Patwari
Bank Account Passbook (Kisan Credit Card / Savings account)
